arabic text: ABBAS (ASWS) TERA HAQ HAI ZAMANA TUJHE ROYE.....
english translation text: O ABBAS, IT IS YOUR RIGHT THAT THE WORLD CRIES FOR YOU

arabic text: JUB SHAAM O SAHER FATEMA ZEHRA (SAWS) TUJHE ROYE.....
english translation text: WHEN FATIMA ZAHRA (SA) CRIES OVER YOU DAY AND NIGHT

arabic text: DURRA LIYE PEHRE PE SITAMGAR (LA) KHADA HAI\nKAISE TERE LASHE PE SAKINA (SAWS) TUJHE ROYE
english translation text: THE OPPRESSOR IS WATCHING VIGILANTLY WITH A WHIP IN HIS\nHANDS, HOW CAN SAKINA CRY ON YOUR DEAD BODY?

arabic text: JIS WAQT UTHAYA NA GAYA LASHA JAWAN KA\nSHEH (ASWS) US GHADI AKBAR (ASWS) SE ZIYADA TUJHE ROYE
english translation text: WHEN IMAM HUSSAIN (AS) WAS UNABLE TO LIFT THE DEAD BODY OF HIS YOUNG\nSON, AT THAT MOMENT, HE CRIED MORE FOR YOU THAN FOR ALI AKBAR

arabic text: ZAINAB (SAWS) NE KAHA SHAAM E GARIBA MEIN AAYE GHAZI, BE PARDA MUJHE DEKH KE BABA TUJHE ROYE
english translation text: ZAINAB SAID THAT THE WARRIOR CAME ON SHAME GHARIBAAN, SEEING ME WITHOUT A VEIL, MY FATHER CRIED FOR YOU

arabic text: SAJDE KE LIYE JUB LIYE HATHO KA SAHARA\nTO SAJJAD (ASWS) MUSALLE PE HUMEHSA TUJHE ROYE
english translation text: WHEN SAJJAD (AS) WOULD TAKE THE SUPPORT OF HIS HANDS TO PERFORM\nPROSTRATIONS, THEN ON THE PRAYER MAT, SAJJAD (AS) WOULD ALWAYS CRY FOR YOU

arabic text: BIN HATH KE KIS TARHA TU GHODE SE GIRA THA\nYEH SUN KE BAHUT AHLE MEDINA TUJHE ROYE
english translation text: ALAS, HOW DID YOU FALL FROM THE HORSE WITHOUT YOUR ARMS?\nLISTENING TO THIS TRAGEDY, THE PEOPLE OF MADINA CRIED FOR YOU

arabic text: MASHKIZA KAHIN JISM KAHIN HATH KAHIN HAI\nJAA JAA KE KAHAN FATEMA ZEHRA (SAWS) TUJHE ROYE
english translation text: THE WATER BAG, YOUR BODY, YOUR ARMS ARE ALL DISPERSED.\nAT WHICH SPOT SHOULD FATIMA ZAHRA (SA) CRY FOR YOU?

arabic text: AARMAN SAKINA (SAWS) KA THA JITNA TUJHE ROTI, SAJJAD (ASWS) TERI QABAR PE UTNA TUJHE ROYE
english translation text: AS MUCH AS SAKINA WISHED TO CRY FOR YOU, SAJJAD (AS) CRIED THAT MUCH FOR YOU ON YOUR GRAVE

arabic text: HASHIM KE QAMAR KYUN NA TERA CHAHNE WALA, WASH SHAMS KA PADH TE HUE SURA TUJHE ROYE
english translation text: O HASHIM AND QAMAR (POET), WHY SHOULD NOT YOUR LOVER, CRY FOR YOU WHILE RECITING THE SURAH OF WA SHAMS?
